headline_en: Fed rate hike and rising yields pressured stocks last session amid mixed pre-market cues.

market_mood.explanation_en: The 65.7 regime score is like a yellow traffic light — not red enough to stay parked, but not green enough to floor the gas. It means selective buying only on clear technical breaks rather than broad market chasing today.

big_picture.summary_en: The Fed delivered a rate hike this week with Chair Warsh signaling further path questions, driving yields sharply higher and equities lower. Reports indicate Saudi oil export cancellations keep geopolitical energy risk elevated without immediate supply disruption.

big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX at 14.81 reflects calm conditions with subdued fear levels across the market.

big_picture.rates_note_en: 10-year yield at 5.00% is elevated and increasing discount rates, weighing on growth and high-valuation stocks.
big_picture.rates_note_ko: 10년물 국채 금리가 5.00%로 높아 차입 비용이 늘어나 성장주와 고평가 종목에 부담을 주고 있습니다.
big_picture.dollar_note_en: The dollar index (DXY) is at 100.22, showing stability that may cap upside for tech and global earnings due to limited currency tailwinds.

big_picture.btc_note_en: Bitcoin is at $80,997.49, up 0.12% today and 3.63% over five days. This signals steady but not overheated risk appetite.

issues.title_en: Fed hikes rates; Warsh signals path ahead

issues.current_state_en: FOMC hiked rates this week with Chair Kevin Warsh at the helm; Treasury yields rose sharply and equities posted worst week since March.

issues.summary_ko: Fed가 Warsh 발언과 함께 금리 인상을 단행하면서 향후 경로에 대한 의문이 제기됐고, 국채 금리 급등으로 주식과 신용 비용이 상승했다.
